candidates.location_hint: the Apply button when it is in the disabled state
candidates.why: The white text remains unchanged while the button background shifts to a light gray, creating a luminance difference that should be manually verified against minimum contrast thresholds.

candidates.location_hint: the helper text paragraph positioned below the Apply button
candidates.why: When the button transitions from enabled to disabled, the helper text is linked via description but may not dynamically announce its content to screen readers without additional live region handling.

candidates.location_hint: the state attributes applied to the Apply button
candidates.why: Both the native disabled attribute and an aria-disabled attribute are applied simultaneously, which could cause redundant or inconsistent state announcements across different assistive technologies.

candidates.location_hint: the default option in the region dropdown menu
candidates.why: The default dropdown option uses an empty value string, which some screen readers may read ambiguously rather than clearly indicating a neutral or unselected filter state.
